text:
Type: modular armless sofa bed
Use: seating, sleeping guests, lounging; living room, guest room, TV room, studio
Style: contemporary, modern, minimalist
Materials: removable fabric covers, foam seat modules, low black feet
Colors: light grey, white and grey patterned module
Shape: low armless modules, loose rectangular back cushions on thin backrests, one module set forward like a chaise, flat seats, open sides
Feel: flexible, casual, relaxed
Goes with: white walls, light wood, black accents, grey rugs; modern, minimalist or Scandinavian living rooms
